description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for five tiny-model fine-tuning variants. The x-axis is labeled “epoch” on a linear scale, spanning 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER” on a linear scale, with labeled ticks at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70 (range shown roughly from the low 20s up to about 70). The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” series is a solid gray line with circular markers, decreasing from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 60 (epoch 1), ~55 (epoch 2), ~45 (epoch 3), ~40 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~36 (epoch 6). The “tiny” series is a solid gray line with square markers, moving from about 60 at epoch 0 to ~51 (epoch 1), ~50 (epoch 2), ~43 (epoch 3), ~37 (epoch 4), ~35 (epoch 5), and ~32 (epoch 6). The “tiny int4” series is a dashed gray line with circular markers, dropping from about 69 at epoch 0 to ~55 (epoch 1), ~49 (epoch 2), ~44 (epoch 3), ~39 (epoch 4), then staying near ~39 (epoch 5) and ending near ~40 (epoch 6). The “tiny int8” series is a dashed gray line with square markers, decreasing from about 60 at epoch 0 to ~47 (epoch 1), ~46 (epoch 2), ~43 (epoch 3), ~38 (epoch 4), ~37 (epoch 5), and ~37 (epoch 6). The “tiny full” series is a dotted gray line with triangle markers, starting near ~29 at epoch 0 and moving to ~27 (epoch 1), ~27 (epoch 2), ~24 (epoch 3), ~24 (epoch 4), ~23.5 (epoch 5), and ~23 (epoch 6).
